Stack Overflow reviewed Q&A adaptations — CC BY-SA 4.0

The three Chinese summaries in native/knowledge_sources.py under
REVIEWED_ANSWERS are edited/abridged translations and explanations derived from:

1. Aaron Hall and subsequent contributors, answer 26853961
   "How can I merge two Python dictionaries in a single expression?"
   https://stackoverflow.com/a/26853961
2. Bite code and subsequent contributors, answer 6581949
   "What are metaclasses in Python?"
   https://stackoverflow.com/a/6581949
3. Du D. and subsequent contributors, answer 36798076
   "@staticmethod vs @classmethod in Python"
   https://stackoverflow.com/a/36798076

Source API: https://api.stackexchange.com/docs/answers-by-ids
The reader accepts only these exact answer/question/author ids and the
content_license value "CC BY-SA 4.0". Source text is inspected for reviewed
markers; unreviewed instructions, profiles, scores, comments, code and links
are not persisted or executed. These checks detect schema changes, not prove
factual truth. No endorsement by Stack Exchange or the authors is implied.
